# David L. Richter Named Chief Executive Officer at BE&K Building Group
## August 10, 2026
Raleigh, NC – August 10, 2026 – BE&K Building Group (BE&K), a leading design-build and construction management services company with more than 55 years of national experience delivering complex, high-performance projects, has announced that David L.
Richter, PE, PMP, CCQM, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Frank Holley, who has served as the company’s CEO since 2019, has transitioned to the role of Chairman as part of a planned leadership succession.
Nidal Zayed, Chairman, President, and CEO of Pernix Group (BE&K’s parent company), remarked that this transition honors the company’s growth under Frank’s leadership and sets the stage for its next chapter under David. “Under Frank’s guidance, BE&K has achieved significant growth in recent years.

...

Reflecting on the transition, Holley shared, “Leading this company as its CEO for the past seven years has been the privilege of my career, and I am immensely proud of what we have accomplished together.

...

Richter is a civil engineer, attorney, and successful business executive with more than 30 years of experience in executive leadership, strategic planning, project management, infrastructure development, corporate law and governance, and mergers and acquisitions in the engineering and construction industry.

...

As Richter assumes the company’s leadership, BE&K will remain focused on executing its strategic priorities, continuing to safely deliver outstanding service to its clients, investing in its employees, and creating long-term value for its stakeholders.

...

**Media Contact:**
Erica Jordy
Communications Manager
BE&K Building Group
erica.jordy@bekbg.com
###
_Left to right: Pat Chisholm, President, BE&K Building Group; Nidal Zayed, CEO, President, & Chairman of the Board, Pernix Group; David Richter, CEO, BE&K Building Group; Frank Holley, Chairman, BE&K Building Group_
